venueSrc.note: No SGE2015 placemark roll exists (the pastvtr venue API is dead): each 2015 venue row is NAME-MATCHED to the next election's committed SG1901 placemarks, strictly within its own district's roll (psrc stamps each matched row's 2019 source and translation lane: exact or alias name equality, or the 2015-only 'RO Pre-Poll'->'EM Office' and 'Pre-Poll'->'EVC'/bare translation lanes; the EVC lane asserts the matched record's locality names the labelled town). Same-premises at a plausible-consistent location, NOT a proven identical venue: rows that matched no plausible 2019 home carry null premises/lat/lon and null psrc — renamed or closed venues, hospital report rows the roll never carried, and RO offices served from a neighbouring district. Vote counts ride the 2015 pages regardless. Declared Institution teams and the declaration piles (postal/absent/enrolment/iVote/provisional-silent) are never geocoded by design.
